text.card: A red giant 3,341 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.13 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,060 K at its surface.
